notes.title: New Patch Released (April 30th 2014)
notes.notes:
We've just released a new patch for Outlast today.

It's a little over 1Gb. It includes:

- Support for Whistleblower DLC (to be released next week, May 6th!)
- Adding Achievements
- Adding the Insane mode: one life at hardest difficulty. Good luck :)
- Support for Japanese language
- Lots of small bug fixes and improvements

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
A new update is now available for Outlast.

· 2 new difficulty levels: Hard & Nightmare

· Struggle mini-games have been revamped and the "mouse shaking" mechanic has been removed

· Added options to disable motion blur and hide interaction prompts

· Added Polish language support

· General optimization and various bug fixes

Hope you like it!

If you need technical support, please contact support@redbarrelsgames.com
For anything else, please email info@redbarrelsgames.com
